title: Magazine p. 47: "Said to be ranging lights" Gemini-12 photo; Gemini-11 Proton-3 discussion
description: Photocopied magazine page with a dark, mostly featureless photograph (numbered 14) captioned "'Said to be ranging lights' on Gemini-12, according to Sandler. Compare with earlier photo showing Agena in the sunlight. Deliberate slanting of evidence." The article text describes the Gemini-11 sighting reported by astronaut Charles "Pete" Conrad, NORAD tracking limitations, and the identification of the object as the Proton-3 satellite. A handwritten note reads "see plates 17, 18, 19, 23, 24."
